machine: MacBook Pro Mac15,6, Apple M3 Pro, 36 GB, macOS 15.7.3
implementation: Qwen3.8-specific compiled-image format, C/Metal runtime, tokenizer, sampler, batched prefill, FP16 KV cache and adaptive MTP speculative decoding

verification.image_format: 68/68 runtime files use Qwen3.8 names and .q38* formats; sampled magic values Q38M3GLB, Q38TOK1, Q38M3Q4, Q38M3ATT and Q38M3MTP
verification.prefill_parity_test: 36/36 pass across 12 lengths from 16 to 131 tokens and three execution modes; argmax identical on every run, zero NaN; exact mode remains bitwise for runs without 32-token chunks
verification.smoke: 2+2 -> 4; C max2 correct; capital-of-France in Chinese -> Paris
verification.mtp_image_smoke: one through ten generated correctly; 19 visible tokens, first token 1.54 s, 13.0 decode tok/s, 13 drafts accepted over 7 steps
verification.mtp_output_parity: default fast verify: 3/5 five-workload cases token-identical to plain greedy; prose and essay flip one numerical near-tie each onto an alternate fluent greedy continuation; QWEN38_VERIFY_FAST=0 restores 5/5 token-identity (9.81 aggregate e2e); every emitted token remains the argmax of a true model forward

throughput_matrix.method: five-case resident-chat matrix, one process per arm, greedy seed 42; adaptive MTP with replay-free partial accepts, eight-wide half-MMA verify, depth ceiling 7 and four-gram context-lookup drafting

aggregate.definition: end-to-end = completion tokens / full request wall (prompt prefill + first token + decode); decode = tokens per interval after the first token; per-case token counts differ between arms where the fast verify takes an alternate greedy branch

thinking_mode.implemented: per-request reasoning_effort (low/medium/xhigh/none) with the verbatim template injections; reply opens at <think>; reasoning_content/content split in stream and plain paths; preserve_thinking replay

verified.xhigh_stream: 301 chars reasoning + correct split answer (6 primes between 10 and 30)
verified.low_with_small_budget: 400-token budget exhausted mid-think: truncated thinking in reasoning_content, empty content, finish_reason length

quality_arc_easy_5.observation: every miss states the correct answer's content in prose without completing the required 'Answer: X' line; this five-case generative adaptation is a smoke test, not an official ARC-Easy score

llama_cpp_unsloth_comparison.stack: llama.cpp build 10360 (Metal, flash attention, llama-server resident, context 4096)
llama_cpp_unsloth_comparison.weights: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Q4_K_M, revision f1bfb127c64f7072bdd2cad55f258b9c8b2910fe, file sha256 7e78da5d7e3ae28d178121f58646953305f3e5bd3cb46f4a75584e8b6c6fe169, 17,106,775,008 bytes
llama_cpp_unsloth_comparison.method: same rendered 36-token prompt, 28-token greedy completion (this model's natural reply length), one warmup then four measured requests per stack, model resident in both
llama_cpp_unsloth_comparison.summary: this runtime leads 1.09x end to end without speculation and 1.56x with it (output token-identical to plain decoding); llama.cpp's reply is correct but differs textually - a different Q4 quantization of the same model
llama_cpp_unsloth_comparison.regression: the runtime's replies match the recorded 3.8 outputs exactly after the wide-tile/S128 prefill changes, with and without speculation

memory_for_speed_experiments.question: decode streams every weight byte per token, so spare RAM can buy speed only as more tokens verified per weight stream; two candidates were built and measured same-window (thermal drift makes cross-window comparison unreliable)

context_lookup_drafting.design: when the tokens just generated reproduce an earlier n-gram of the conversation, draft up to 7 followers with no draft-model pass and verify them in one batched forward (verify batches 2-8), with a cooldown after failed lookups

same_window_ab.summary_case: 7.97 tok/s lookup off vs 7.17 on; 5 lookup steps accepted 17 drafts (3.4/step)
same_window_ab.prose_with_bigram_trigger: 4 accepts in 23 lookup steps - misfires dominate

context_lookup_drafting.why_it_loses: a partial accept pays the wide verify plus a replay (state repair), ~130 ms per emitted token at 3.4/7 accepts versus ~100 for the MTP chain; the exact-kernel verify also grows ~0.7 ms/layer per extra row
context_lookup_drafting.disposition: reverted; would need carry-forward verification (fold the accepted prefix into the next step's verify instead of replaying) to reach parity, and parity is not a win

adaptive_depth_ceiling_5.design: raise the adaptive MTP chain ceiling from 3 to 5 above acceptance EMA 0.99
adaptive_depth_ceiling_5.same_window_ab: long code case: 10.84 tok/s at fixed depth 3 vs 10.71 adaptive-with-ceiling-5; docstring spans dip the EMA so deep steps rarely engage and shallow recovery steps dominate

memory_for_speed_experiments.weight_copy_analysis: an FP16 weight copy for a dequant-free verify path needs ~27 GB next to the 14.1 GiB Q4 image - exceeds 36 GB; a Q8 copy (~29 GB total resident) risks swap for a marginal dequant saving; not attempted
memory_for_speed_experiments.retained: verify pipeline sets for batches 2-8, an 8-row logits buffer, per-position GDN factor checkpoints (~82 MB) and replay-free partial accepts; QWEN38_MTP_DEPTH accepts fixed depths up to 7 (default remains adaptive with ceiling 3)

replay_free_partial_accepts.design: the batch<=8 prefill sets side-write per-position GDN factors during the speculative verify (conv windows 63 MB, delta key/value 2x9.4 MB, decay/beta 2x74 KB, ~82 MB total); a partial accept restores the pre-verify recurrent snapshot, re-runs the in-buffer delta recurrence over the accepted rows from those factors and restores the conv window checkpoint - no weight traffic - then hands the corrected token over as the next pending token instead of replaying a forward

same_window_three_arm.method: plain / rollback / replay arms, one resident process each, sequential in one window, five workloads
same_window_three_arm.run_2_aggregate_e2e: plain 7.59, rollback 9.81 tok/s (replay arm invalidated by a concurrent rebuild)
same_window_three_arm.essay_largest_gain: 9.21-9.35 rollback vs 8.80 replay e2e; 866 steps, 712 accepts
same_window_three_arm.output: rollback token-identical to plain on 5/5 cases in the record run

replay_free_partial_accepts.budget_guard_fix: the chat loop previously stopped speculative stepping 8 tokens before the reply budget, truncating capped replies up to 7 tokens short of plain; it now steps to the budget and truncates the final step's emission, so budget-capped replies match plain exactly
replay_free_partial_accepts.disposition: kept; QWEN38_REPLAY=1 selects the old replay path for comparison

small_batch_mma_verify.problem: the exact scalar batch GEMM pays ~46 ms per extra verify row (instruction-issue-bound at ~2 instructions per weight pair per row, uniform across delta and attention layers), so verify cost was 178/234/277/327/392/444/510 ms at depths 1-7 and deep draft chains could not pay

failed_attempts.route_verify_to_32wide_mma: existing prompt-chunk MMA kernels pay for a full 32-row batch tile regardless of real batch: flat ~513-528 ms at depths 1-3, 3x slower end-to-end, one essay argmax flip
failed_attempts.transposed_activation_scalar_kernels: producer-transposed [column][8] activation packs with vector FMA: per-simdgroup padding re-reads made cost flat ~294-303 ms at batches 2-4, worse than scalar everywhere
failed_attempts.threadgroup_staged_variant: cooperative 16 KB activation tiles cut L2 rebound but occupancy losses made batch 8 worse (558 ms)

small_batch_mma_verify.solution: eight-wide half-MMA GEMM kernels: batch tile of 8, the four simdgroups split the 64-column K-tile and their partial tiles sum through the existing spill path; weight staging identical to the 32-wide kernels; float-activation GEMMs read a half copy the producer kernels write in the same encoder, so no conversion dispatches
small_batch_mma_verify.measured_verify_cost: flat 204-212 ms from batch 2 through batch 8 (~1.3 ms marginal row); hybrid routing keeps batch 2 on the exact scalar path (167 ms); depth-7 verify 211 ms vs 510 ms scalar
small_batch_mma_verify.adaptive_depth: with ~7 ms per marginal chain level the ceiling rose from 3 to 7 with acceptance-EMA tiers 0.85/0.70/0.55/0.40 -> depths 7/5/3/2
small_batch_mma_verify.same_window_ab: plain 7.71 vs fast MTP 10.41 aggregate e2e tok/s; LRUCache 14.19 e2e (decode 14.48), C max2 12.04 e2e (decode 30.37); prose-class cases 9.1-9.4 e2e remain acceptance-limited
small_batch_mma_verify.numerics: half-MMA accumulation order differs from the exact path: 3/5 battery cases token-identical to plain greedy, prose and essay each flip one numerical near-tie and continue on an alternate fluent greedy branch (inspected, no degeneration); QWEN38_VERIFY_FAST=0 restores the exact kernels and 5/5 token-identity at 9.81 aggregate; QWEN38_PREFILL_MMA=0 exact mode is unchanged and bitwise (36/36 parity)
small_batch_mma_verify.capture_kernels: checkpoint and half-copy side outputs live in separate _cap kernel variants so the exact kernels keep their original code generation; a store added inside the hot kernels measurably perturbed fast-math contraction and broke exact-mode bitwise parity until split out

context_lookup_drafting_v2.design: runtime-level lookup drafting layered on the fast verify: when the four-token suffix ending at the pending token recurs in the request's token history, up to seven follower tokens replace the MTP draft chain with zero draft-model passes; gated to acceptance EMA <= 0.70 so it never displaces a strong code chain, cooldown 16 steps after a zero-accept lookup

iterations.trigram_ungated: aggregate 10.09 - misfiring code trigrams displaced the MTP chain (LRUCache 12.89 vs 14.19)
iterations.trigram_ema_gated: LRUCache recovered to 14.36; essay still lost ~4% to prose function-word trigram misfires
iterations.fourgram_ema_gated: kept: aggregate 10.38 with prose 9.79 (best) and code long 14.17

context_lookup_drafting_v2.why_it_works_now: the 2026-08-16 chat-layer version lost (7.17 vs 7.97) because a partial accept paid a wide verify plus a replay; with replay-free rollback and a flat-cost verify a misfired lookup step costs roughly one shallow MTP step
context_lookup_drafting_v2.ema_note: the acceptance EMA counts accepted drafts plus at most one miss per step (chain positions past the first reject were never tested); the uncensored update crashed the estimate by 0.85^7 on one bad deep step
